purpose: Record applicability and evidence-backed verdicts for OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 chapter V1 (Encoding and Sanitization) — 30 requirements — in the machine-readable decision register, with no code changes.
requiredInvariants: Every V1 requirement is either an explicit decision (APPLICABLE with PASS/FAIL, or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION with a real self-revoking condition) or is deliberately left undeclared to fall through to the honest PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSED default — never an explicit NOT_ASSESSED decision with no condition, since the evidence gate correctly rejects those.

Every applicability=NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION decision has status=NOT_APPLICABLE and vice versa, verified across the whole decisions file before every push, not only the newly-added rows — the exact class of bug caught by CI on PR #4606.
A PASS or FAIL is only recorded where the underlying code was read and the cited pattern verified against the live tree in this pass.
Findings that name real gaps (unescaped XML/CSV report building, unsanitized regex construction from request-body keys) are recorded as evidence for future remediation, not fixed here.
No security control is weakened; Semgrep, the pinning ratchet and every other gate stay at full strength.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
This scope changes no application code.
acceptance: docs/security/asvs-applicability-decisions.json gains exactly 27 new V1.* explicit decisions and no duplicates; the remaining 3 V1 requirements stay undeclared (PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSED).
The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions; decisionsApplied increases by 27; finalPass stays false.
scripts/security/*.test.mjs stays 60/60 (JSON-only change, no script logic touched).
A file-wide applicability/status consistency check (not just the new rows) reports 0 inconsistencies before every push.
Every FAIL and PASS note cites a real file and pattern checked against the live tree in this pass.
